scientific_hypothesis: Constraining individual layer thicknesses to a maximum of 280nm and increasing mutation step-sizes in the 100-150nm regime will redistribute sampling density to resolve narrow spectral features, improving dual-band performance and altering the tightest_margin relative to the unbounded 24-layer baseline.
known_risks: Bounded space may exclude global optimum if >280nm layers are physically required
expected_observations: If hypothesis holds: best_target_score should exceed route_01's best by at least 0.1, with tightest_margin showing improved band-edge sharpness
If hypothesis fails: best_target_score should converge to similar values as route_01, indicating periodicity is sufficient
thicknesses_nm should show non-uniform distribution if aperiodic optimization finds advantage
stop_conditions: If best_target_score improves by less than 1e-3 against the historical best for two consecutive rounds, treat the axis as exhausted, stop and keep the current best
If valid_candidates drops below 5 for three consecutive rounds, reduce optimization dimensionality and stop
